headline: Congress required certain railroads and their unions to accept the latest unratified tentative agreements in their unresolved contract disputes.
what_it_does: This joint resolution settles unresolved labor disputes between certain railroads and their employees. It requires both sides to accept the most recent tentative agreements, side letters, and local carrier agreements that had not been ratified before the law was enacted. The disputes involved railroads represented by the National Carriers' Conference Committee of the National Railway Labor Conference.

who_it_affects.group: Railroads represented by the National Carriers' Conference Committee
who_it_affects.how: They must accept the unratified tentative agreements, side letters, and local carrier agreements as the resolution of their disputes with employee unions.

who_it_affects.group: Railroad employees represented by labor unions in these disputes
who_it_affects.how: The unratified agreements now apply to them in place of continued bargaining, so the terms in those agreements govern their pay and working conditions covered by the disputes.
